_comment: Accessibility scanning rules. The page list is generated from
To skip a page, add it to `exclude` with a reason. Keep that short:
every entry is a page nobody is checking.
Two engines run on every page: HTML CodeSniffer (WCAG2AA, the older
2.0-era ruleset) and axe-core, which adds the WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 rules.
Both must pass. A rule name starting with a lowercase word and hyphens
(e.g. heading-order) is axe; one starting WCAG2AA. is CodeSniffer.
